structured_output.summary: Phase 21's phase-governance chunk registers phases 21-25 coherently and the recorded evidence is real: the 14-command phase-21 report matches commands_for(21) exactly, every exit code is 0, and it is bound to the reviewed source hash 7c4a07f7... with source_unchanged true. The SDK freeze against 0a213fe79c is enforced two ways (tracked diff plus an untracked-file assertion), later milestones fail closed (red_team_management.py:287 raises unconditionally for 22-25), chunk scope binding is enforced before the reviewer is invoked, the phase-21 >=9/10 plan floor exists, and docs/PHASES.md plus phase-status.json agree with the implemented thresholds (42 chunk / 46 phase / attempt-five >40). Eight new governance regression tests executed green. The weaknesses are latent gate-design and coverage gaps rather than functional errors: the new phase gates lack the vendor-YAML whitespace exclusion that phases 12/15/17 all carry (the new spec has 46 trailing-whitespace lines, so the gate passes only while that file is untracked); check_evidence ignores the contracts-only scope marker and for phase 21 the CI subset is byte-identical to the full list, contradicting the "can never substitute" claim in PHASES.md:148; the phase-21 list omits test_ci.py and every other contracts/manifest.json consumer although this phase edits the manifest and check_phase.py itself; the plan-score-floor test is insensitive (it passes with the floor deleted); the 21-25 literal phase set is duplicated four times in review_phase.py with no test covering verify_record's scope binding for those phases; and a timed-out review permanently dead-ends its attempt loop, as the orphaned plan-and-provenance prompt currently demonstrates. No blocker or high finding: every category >=8, total 42/50, accepted at the chunk floor but below the 45 aim.

findings.description: The shared management command list for phases 21-25 uses unqualified `git diff --check` and `git diff --cached --check`. The newly vendored spec contracts/vendor/red-team-management/0.86.0/mp-openapi.yaml contains 46 lines with trailing whitespace, so these commands will report whitespace errors as soon as that file is staged (or re-pinned in phase 25). The recorded pass holds only because the vendor tree is still untracked. Phases 12, 15 and 17 (lines 212-213, 190-191, 169) all carry an explicit `:(exclude)` pathspec for their vendor YAML for exactly this reason, so the new gates are weaker than their precedent and the remedy at that point would be either editing vendor bytes or changing the command list (which invalidates accepted reviews).
findings.required_fix: Add the vendor exclusion to the management common list, e.g. ["git", "diff", "--check", "--", ".", ":(exclude)contracts/vendor/red-team-management/0.86.0/*.yaml"] and the same for --cached, matching commands_for(12)/(15)/(17); if committed-source hygiene is intended, also add a committed-range check with the same exclusion.

findings.description: check_evidence validates phase, passed, source hash and the command list but ignores the report's `scope` field written by check_phase.py:606 ("ci_contracts_only_not_full_phase_qualification"). For phase 21 ci_commands_for(21) is byte-identical to commands_for(21) (no scripts/check-rust.py, check-package.py, check-native-exports.py, check-access-release.py or generate_models --verify-fixtures appear in the phase-21 list), so docs/checks/phase-21-contracts.json renamed to docs/checks/phase-21.json would satisfy the gate. docs/checks/ is excluded from the review fingerprint (review_phase.py:15), so such a substitution leaves no trace in the reviewed source hash, directly contradicting docs/PHASES.md:148 ("it can never substitute for the complete phase check list"). tools/test_management_phases.py:52 deliberately excludes phase 21 from its incompleteness assertion, so the documented invariant is untested and false for this phase.
findings.required_fix: Make check_evidence reject any report carrying the contracts-only scope marker (e.g. require report.get("scope") is None), and extend tools/test_management_phases.py:44 to cover phase 21 so the invariant is enforced rather than merely documented.

findings.description: The phase-21 gate runs only verify-contracts, red_team_management, generate_validation, generate_models, three unit suites and the private-material receipt. It omits tools/test_ci.py even though this phase modifies check_phase.py, the module whose commands_for/ci_commands_for output test_ci.py asserts against the committed .forgejo workflow and docs/CI.md. It also omits every other contracts/manifest.json consumer (tools/model_fixtures.py, tools/verify_native_fixtures.py, tools/generate_constants.py, tools/response_defaults.py, tools/native_exports.py, tools/red_team_dataplane.py --require-complete, tools/schema-oracle.mts, tools/verify-gateway-specimens.mts) while this phase adds a new source and four vendorArtifacts entries to that manifest. The recorded evidence therefore cannot show that the shared CI contract and the manifest-dependent generators are unaffected; that regression surface is only covered by remote phase-20 CI, which this branch has not demonstrated.
findings.required_fix: Add ["python", "-m", "unittest", "discover", "-s", "tools", "-p", "test_ci.py", "-v"] plus the manifest-consuming --check commands (model_fixtures, verify_native_fixtures, generate_constants, response_defaults, native_exports, red_team_dataplane --check --require-complete and the schema/specimen oracles) to commands_for(21), and rerun the gate.

findings.description: test_plan_score_floor_cannot_be_bypassed_by_category_total is insensitive. Its fixture writes only the review record; no .prompt.md or .cli.json sibling exists, so verify_record would return False at review_phase.py:237-240 even if the phase-21 >=9/10 floor at review_phase.py:235 were deleted. The single new test guarding the documented plan-gate floor (docs/PHASES.md:135) therefore cannot fail on regression.
findings.required_fix: Give the fixture complete evidence (prompt, cli envelope with matching structured_output, and a passing checks snapshot) and assert both directions: verify_record is True at score 9 with the same categories and False at score 8.5, so deleting review_phase.py:235 breaks the test.

findings.description: A timed-out or errored review preserves destination.prompt.md and the .checks.json snapshot but never writes the record (asserted by test_review_phase.py:308-310). Line 427 then refuses to reuse that attempt ("Review attempt already exists"), while verify_attempt_sequence (line 86) reads every earlier attempt's .json and raises on a missing file, so attempt N+1 cannot be requested either. The chunk/phase loop dead-ends with no documented recovery, and the condition is live: docs/reviews/phase-21-chunk-plan-and-provenance-attempt-01.prompt.md and .checks.json exist with no record or .cli.json.
findings.required_fix: Persist an explicit incomplete/failed attempt artifact that verify_attempt_sequence accepts as a consumed attempt (or permit re-requesting an attempt whose record was never written), and document the recovery path in docs/PHASES.md.

findings.description: "Keep the existing phase20 workflow unchanged during planning and implementation" combined with .forgejo/workflows/ci.yml remaining pinned to --phase 20 --verification-only --contracts-only (asserted at tools/test_ci.py:504-506) means no remote CI exercises the new governance tooling (tools/red_team_management.py, tools/test_management_phases.py, commands_for(21)) for phases 21-23, even though CONTRACT_CI_PHASES at tools/check_phase.py:71 advertises a per-phase contracts receipt and PHASES.md:148 states one exists "for each new phase". The capability is registered but never executed remotely until phase 24 updates routing.
findings.required_fix: Either route CI to the active phase's contracts subset now (updating docs/CI.md, docs/RELEASE.md and test_ci.py together), or state explicitly in docs/PHASES.md that the new management tooling has no remote CI coverage before phase 24 so the gap is recorded rather than implied to be covered.

findings.description: The literal `phase == 20 or phase in {21, 22, 23, 24, 25}` is duplicated at lines 241, 431, 496 and 544 instead of reusing a constant (check_phase.MANAGEMENT_PHASES already exists at check_phase.py:70). A future phase added to check_phase.py but missed in one of these four places silently loses review_scope recording, prompt-scope binding or declared-scope verification. Coverage is also thin: test_review_phase.py exercises chunk orchestration with phase 19, which does not enter this branch, and no test asserts that verify_record rejects a phase-21 chunk record with a tampered review_scope, mismatched scope_evidence or altered "Chunk scope artifacts:" prompt line.
findings.required_fix: Hoist a single module-level constant for scope-bound phases (importing or mirroring check_phase.MANAGEMENT_PHASES) and add a verify_record test for a phase-21 chunk record covering tampered review_scope, mismatched scope_evidence and a modified prompt scope line.

findings.description: gate_decision does not know about the phase-21 plan-score floor applied separately at lines 235 and 528, so a phase-21 phase review scoring below 9/10 is written with "decision": "accepted" while "gate_passed" is false. Advancement is still blocked because verify_record re-applies the floor, but the persisted artifact's decision field contradicts its own gate result and would mislead anyone reading docs/reviews/ or the accepted_* fields copied by accepted_chunks.
findings.required_fix: Fold the phase-21 >=9/10 plan floor into gate_decision (passing the phase through) so decision, gate_passed and the recorded status agree, and keep the duplicate guards as assertions only.
